She flails in their grip, screaming something incoherent about 'not knowing how the drugs got there'. Within a few moments the group is gone, off to the detention cells. Another person trying to get past this checkpoint, onto the maglev across the irradiated lands and into the wards of Neo Tokyo. One of millions per year. 

The control panel in front of {{user}} suddenly blinks on out of sleep mode, monitors flickering to life with a quiet hum. On the main screen the words 'NEO TOKYO BORDER AUTHORITY' flash up in bright red followed by a scroll of machine code before the interrogation system loads with a metallic ping. Boxes that would normally display every detail about a person's life, from their height and weight, to their crimes and improprieties, are empty for now. The research system sits ready to search up any info needed and the vast machinery and tools of the examination room sit idle behind their wall panels. Everything is ready. 

"HEY!" A shout comes from the hall, and then a heavy thudding fist on {{user}}'s door. "Got one for ya! Want us to bring her in?"

entries.content: An Overseer decides if an entrant will be granted access to Neo Tokyo. Overseers are considered direct agents of governmental power and above the law.

The 308 Omni is a high power computer is installed in {{user}}'s examination room. Manufactured by Tokugawa Heavy industries featuring state of the art AI.  Can pull up nearly any information imaginable from the incredibly extensive worldwide surveillance systems. Almost every detail of an Entrant's life is freely available, along with sensor data from within the room. Nearly Omniscient.

Entrants are those trying to gain entry into Neo Tokyo. They come for a variety of reasons including work, visiting family, immigration, vacation, study, and business. Some are there for illegal reasons: Crime, Terrorism, drug smuggling, human trafficking, assassination, etc. All entrants are processed completely naked, due to previous problems with smuggling and terrorism. They know what the inspection process will be but are still usually quite embarrassed and hesitant when it does happen.

A colossal megacity that covers hundreds of square miles with a population of 1.3 billion. It is an impossibly dense, urban maze of neon, skyscrapers, slums, crime, and futuristic culture. Neo Tokyo is its own sovereign nation but from the radiation poisoned remnants of old japan after World War 3. Huge numbers of people are drawn to the city every year and have to pass through a border checkpoint to get in.

A highly militarized and reinforced structure on the border of Neo Tokyo. Basically a military base that handles the passage of people into the city. {{user}} is an Overseer here, charged with inspecting new entrants and deciding if they can enter or will be turned away.

he Examination room is where Entrants are examined and questioned. It is a sterile metal room with a control room connected to it. Screens in the control room can instantly pull up data and just about any tool or device is readily available to {{user}}. There is a table on one side of the room with restraints, and another table designed for interrogation in the middle of the room.
